issuer.name: Lead Bank (legal line on phantom.com/cash, the 'Understanding your Cash account' article and the learn page updated 2026-11-20: 'The Prepaid Debit Visa Card is issued by Lead Bank pursuant to licensing by Visa U.S.A. Inc.'; 'Bridge Ventures LLC is the program manager for the card on behalf of Lead Bank') — but the help article 'Update your replacement virtual Phantom debit card (US)' states 'Phantom is moving from Bridge to Stripe as our debit card issuer', with Bridge-issued cards replaced in stages from 5 October 2026. The bank behind the Stripe-issued card is not named on any page read.

funding.supported_assets_note: The card spends the Cash account balance, held in CASH ('a USD-pegged stablecoin' on Solana) in 'a self-custodial smart-contract wallet on Solana'. At payment the card partner 'draws CASH from your Cash account, converts it to USD'. The Cash account is funded by debit/credit card via Stripe (incl. Apple Pay / Google Pay), US bank direct deposit or wire, or by swapping USDC/USDT/USDG/PYUSD on Solana (free) or other tokens (0.85%) into CASH.

eligibility.nationality_restrictions_note: 'Must be 18 or older to apply.' (legal line). The card is 'available only in the US (except New York)'; 'We don't have a timeline to share for other regions.' New York is excluded by the provider (sub-national exclusion, not representable as an ISO country code).
eligibility.usage_note: Spend article: 'If you're in the US (except New York), you can get a virtual Phantom debit card'. The Cash account itself 'is available to Phantom users in most countries' (not in US-sanctioned jurisdictions; Cash Rewards not in the UK), but the card is US-only on every page read. The 'Feature availability by region' article returned a client error to the fetcher → needs_browser_read. ITIN not accepted for verification (SSN required).

kyc.thresholds_note: US: 'Cash uses progressive verification' for Stripe funding — basic information for a first deposit, more 'as the amount goes up' (no amount thresholds published). For the debit card itself verification is required outright: US (except New York) requires verification for 'Stripe funding, direct bank deposits and withdrawals, and the Phantom debit card'. Card limits are not tied to verification level: standard $2,000/day, $5,000/day after the Cash account is 30 days old with 30 days of transaction history.
kyc.stages_note: Account creation and on-chain Cash features: 'You're not required to KYC to use Phantom or Phantom Cash' (phantom.com/cash FAQ). Card order: 'To get a card, you'll need to verify your identity.' Verification is run by 'Link, Stripe's service'; information that may be requested: phone number, date of birth, residential address (no P.O. box), Social Security Number, government-issued ID and a selfie. 'Phantom cannot manually review, approve, or override a verification decision.'

access.note: Fees article, 'Fees for the Phantom debit card': virtual card issuance 'Free'. No plan or subscription exists.

fees.conditions: No monthly, annual or maintenance fee appears on the fees article or any other page read; no page states that there is none. Left unknown rather than free.

Funding the Cash account (the card's only balance): debit card via Stripe incl. Apple Pay / Google Pay 1.75%; credit card via Stripe 3.50%; direct deposit from a US bank 0.30%; domestic wire 1.00%; swap of USDC, USDT, USDG or PYUSD on Solana into Cash 'Free'; other tokens into Cash 0.85%. Modelled: the debit-card route (1.75%); a stablecoin swap is free.
Swapping USDC, USDT, USDG or PYUSD on Solana into Cash: 'Free'. Swaps from other tokens into Cash: 0.85% (see topup). Card payments: 'Domestic purchases in the US: Free'.
'International purchases (online or in-store): Fees may apply. Phantom shows them before you confirm.' No percentage is published on any page read.

No ATM function: 'ATM withdrawals and cash back are not supported' (learn page); the spend article lists 'cash advances, and ATM withdrawals' among declined transaction types. No fee exists because the capability does not; left unknown rather than free.

rewards.conditions: Not a card reward: Cash Rewards pay '6% annual percentage yield (APY) for everyone enrolled' on CASH held in the Cash account, calculated daily, 'added to your Cash balance every week', no minimum, no cap stated; 'Phantom sets the rate and can raise it, lower it, or pause or end the program'; 'funded by Phantom as a marketing expense'; not available in the UK or US-sanctioned jurisdictions. Card spending earns nothing: 'Cash back functionality is not currently supported.' Recorded here only so the balance yield is not mistaken for cashback; it is excluded from the calculator.
rewards.description: 6% APY on the held CASH balance (variable, provider-funded); no cashback on card spending.

limits.note: 'Standard daily limit: $2,000'; increases to '$5,000 per day' once the Cash account is at least 30 days old with 30 days of transaction history. 'Phantom Support can't increase or manually reset this limit.' Money-transfer (e.g. funding Apple Cash) limit $500 per week.

editorial.summary: Virtual-only prepaid Visa card of the Phantom wallet, spending the balance of a Phantom Cash account (CASH, a USD-pegged stablecoin held in a self-custodial smart-contract wallet on Solana). Available in the United States except New York after identity verification through Stripe's Link; free to issue, free for domestic purchases, works with Apple Wallet and Google Wallet, $2,000 per day rising to $5,000 after 30 days. International purchases carry fees that Phantom only shows at checkout, ATM withdrawals are not supported and there is no cashback; a separate, variable 6% APY applies to the held CASH balance. The card issuer is stated inconsistently: Lead Bank (program manager Bridge Ventures) on the legal lines, while a help article says cards are being reissued through Stripe since October 2026.
good_for: US Phantom users who want to spend a stablecoin balance with a free virtual Visa and Apple/Google Wallet
Spending without a monthly plan: issuance and domestic purchases are free, stablecoin swaps into CASH are free
Users who value self-custody of the spending balance (smart-contract wallet on Solana)
not_for: Residents outside the United States, and residents of New York
Anyone who needs a physical card or ATM access — neither is offered
Cashback seekers: card spending earns nothing; the 6% APY is on the held balance and can be changed or ended by Phantom
Travellers who need a published FX fee: international purchase fees are only shown at confirmation
watch_outs: Issuer stated inconsistently: Lead Bank / Bridge Ventures on the legal lines vs 'moving from Bridge to Stripe as our debit card issuer' from 5 October 2026; the bank behind the Stripe-issued card is not named.
International purchases: 'Fees may apply' — no percentage published.
Funding the Cash account costs 1.75% by debit card, 3.50% by credit card, 0.30% direct deposit, 1.00% wire; only Solana stablecoin swaps are free.
Daily spend limit $2,000 (then $5,000 after 30 days); support cannot raise it; $500/week for money transfers.
The 6% APY on CASH is variable, 'funded by Phantom as a marketing expense' and not available in the UK; it is not a card reward.
'Funds on the Card are not FDIC insured.' (learn page).
Identity verification requires an SSN (ITIN not accepted) and is decided by Stripe/Link; Phantom cannot override it.
Authorization holds can last up to 30 days; Phantom suggests keeping 20% more than the expected bill in the account.
